app_behavior: Show operational constraints and responsible owners; private clinical content stays in care views.
boundary: Role and duty can contextualize a measurement, not diagnose its cause.

app_behavior: Background import with identity, time, unit and quality checks. Surface acquisition failure separately from a health concern.
boundary: No full-time manual dashboard watching or per-sample approvals.

boundary: This assessment is not claimed to happen every day or to be derived from a wrist sensor.

app_behavior: Inspect method and uncertainty; choose a reviewed follow-up, owner and completion condition. Missing evidence can block a conclusion.
boundary: No automatically generated treatment or EVA clearance.

activity: Recorder or gateway fault, if present
app_behavior: See connection state and acquisition metadata; recover queued data without erasing the clinical episode.
boundary: Device repair is a separate task from caring for the person.

app_behavior: Preview exact selected evidence and purpose; freeze a released packet in the local outbox during outage.
boundary: Local task completion continues. Transmission and care have different states.

app_behavior: Show source age, revisions and open questions. Return a response referencing the exact packet.
boundary: No promise of an instantaneous reply or closure on receipt.

app_behavior: Accept ownership transfer or keep it visibly unresolved; record actual completion evidence.
boundary: Being off duty does not silently clear an outstanding task.

app_behavior: Respect the planned rest window; continue acquisition and audit. Route only reviewed alert classes.
